acceptable_use_policy: Data is used for law enforcement purposes only. Data is owned by Pflugerville TX PD and is never sold to 3rd parties.
prohibited_uses: Immigration enforcement, speed enforcement, harassment or intimidation, usage based solely on a protected class (i.e. race, sex, religion), personal use.
access_policy: All system access is controlled by administrators and requires a valid reason which is stored indefinitely, for audit purposes.
hotlist_policy: Hotlist hits are required to be officer verified prior to action.

overview:
Pflugerville TX PD uses Flock Safety technology to capture objective evidence without compromising on individual privacy. Pflugerville TX PD utilizes retroactive search to solve crimes after they've occurred. Additionally, Pflugerville TX PD utilizes real time alerting of hotlist vehicles to capture wanted criminals. In an effort to ensure proper usage and guardrails are in place, they have made the below policies and usage statistics available to the public.

Visit pflugervilletx.gov/safetycameras for the total number of Automated License Plate Readers leased by the Pflugerville PD and more information.
